protocol.timing: Adaptation training plus per-epoch validation; excludes model loading, warm-up and checkpoint writing.
protocol.augmentation: One full-epoch angle vector generated before batching; identical per-image angles and image order for each paired seed/epoch.
protocol.precision: CUDA float16 autocast and GradScaler; validation inference batch 64.
protocol.selection: Validation only. Fixed final epoch; no test labels or predictions accessed.
protocol.timing_repeats: Two technical sessions, reversed order. Three independent training seeds, not six.

recommendation: Batch 32 meets the predefined engineering pilot criteria; it is a candidate for this ResNet recipe.

descriptions.validation_auroc: Ranking performance on the accepted 524-image validation split; mean and sample SD over three seeds. Timing repetitions do not increase seed count.
descriptions.delta: Batch-32 AUROC minus batch-16 AUROC. Negative means worse ranking.
descriptions.speedup: Batch-16 adaptation seconds divided by batch-32 seconds. First take the median across two technical sessions for each seed, then the median across three seeds.
descriptions.memory: Maximum allocated CUDA tensor memory includes resident train/validation arrays; reserved memory also reported. nvidia-smi before/after snapshots include other GPU uses and are not continuous peaks.
descriptions.acceptance: Practical engineering criteria fixed in the original proposal; not a statistical equivalence/non-inferiority test.
descriptions.optimization_scope: Changing physical batch changes optimizer update count: 882 versus 441 over the same 14094 image presentations. This is an operational recipe comparison, not a pure kernel-only speed experiment.
descriptions.augmentation_deviation: V2 generates all angles once per epoch to guarantee paired per-image rotations across batch sizes. V1 drew angles per batch. Therefore rerun batch16 is the appropriate V2 control; do not substitute old V1 test results.
descriptions.scope_limit: ResNet-only, short training budget and existing validation split; no new test evaluation, external validation, or conclusion for DenseNet/MobileNet.
